title: Ramp testimonial wall
description: A centred grey eyebrow, a big 'proof' headline and a grey button, over three rows of white hairline quote cards (16px corners, a small square logo chip, name, role and a grey quote) that drift left on endless loops at different speeds, offset from each other and fading out at both edges.
notes: rows loop with CSS (each row is drawn twice); hovering a row pauses it; with reduced motion the rows sit still
the logo chip takes any node; the demo uses initials
